_why: This repository has no Node in its build and QML has no var() to resolve, so it cannot consume
@redrob-labs/ui the way every other Redrob product does. The delivery anticipates that: it ships
dist/styles/tokens.json with every var() chain already resolved per theme, and dist/native/
redrob_tokens.h as 0xAARRGGBB constants, precisely for a surface that cannot evaluate CSS.
Those two files are vendored here and pinned by sha256. The hash is the gate: a vendored copy that
drifts repaints the whole app in values no other product uses, and nothing in a build would
notice, because a colour literal compiles exactly as well when it is wrong.
tools/generate_design_tokens.py --check verifies both the pin and that qml/RedrobTokens.qml is

vendored_tokens.purpose: every token resolved per theme, for a consumer with no CSS engine
the same colours as 0xAARRGGBB constants, for the C++ host

generated.from: assets/Products/redrob-design-icon.svg, whose symbol path is lifted rather than retyped
